access.name: airflow
access.notes: This stack pins a single Admin user, airflow/airflow, replacing the admin and user fixtures hmd-app-airflow ships. Both are plaintext fixtures in instance_configuration, not secrets.

access.name: trino
access.notes: Any username, no password: local Trino runs with no authenticator, so the name you type becomes the query user. Catalogs hive and graph. The JDBC/CLI port is the one nsctl env status prints.

description: Airflow, Trino and Superset with what they need -- the smallest useful NeuronSphere analytics platform
name: hmd-stack-analytics
